twists: The two measurements disagree, and the disagreement is the signal.
The effect reverses at a scale nobody usually looks at.
An old, unfashionable instrument sees what the new one misses.
The discovery is only visible in data everyone routinely discards.
Two unrelated clocks in the body turn out to be synchronized.
The model is right for a reason its builders would find embarrassing.
A law from a distant field predicts the anomaly exactly.
The control group is the interesting group.
Something meant to be identical twice is informatively different.
The absence everyone corrected for was carrying the information.
